Play.title: Play Riftbound
Play.description: Play Riftbound in your browser: against the AI, online with your decks, or on an organizer's server. The engine applies the rules and cites each one.

status.error: The table could not be loaded.

error.OFFLINE: Online play is not available right now.
error.FORBIDDEN: Only the table host can do this.
error.ALREADY_SEATED: You are already seated at this table.
error.SERVER: The game server did not answer. Try again in a moment.

card.unsupported: The engine cannot play this card yet.

prompt.onTable: Choose on the table: whatever is outlined is allowed.
prompt.mulligan: Click the cards to set aside ({count} of {max}).
prompt.setAside: {count, plural, one {Set # card aside} other {Set # cards aside}}

pace.telling: The table is replaying what just happened…
pace.stopsHint: A card played by an opponent, end of combat, points scored, start of your turn.
pace.cameraHint: It moves in on the battlefield during combat, then pulls back.
pace.effectsHint: Lightning, comets, flames: each card has its own effect. Off at “Instant” speed.
pace.autoPayHint: The suggested payment goes through right away, without showing it.

solo.broken: This game can no longer be resumed: the game engine has been updated since.
solo.none: No game in progress in this browser.

watch.title: You are watching
watch.pausedHint: Game paused on turn {turn}. "Next event" steps forward; the log and cards stay available.
watch.playingHint: The AIs play at the chosen pace. Space pauses.
watch.stopsHint: Card or ability played, end of combat, points scored: the game waits for "Continue".

deck.randomHint: A legend drawn at random each game
deck.label: Deck
deck.refused: {count, plural, one {# deck cannot be played} other {# decks cannot be played}}

lobby.watchHint: Watch AIs play each other, with pause.
lobby.openListsHint: The AIs know the cards in the opposing deck, but not their order or which are in hand. Otherwise they only know what has been shown.
lobby.watchInfo: You watch the game without playing: the AIs' hands are visible, and you can pause at any time.
lobby.resumeWatchTitle: AI vs AI game in progress
lobby.resumeTitle: Game in progress against the AI
lobby.signInForDecks: Sign in to play with your own decks.
lobby.sets: The engine plays the Origins (OGN) and Proving Grounds (OGS) sets.
lobby.onlineHint: Create a table and invite by link.
lobby.hostHint: A game hosted by you or an organizer.
lobby.replaces: Starting a game replaces the one in progress against the AI.
lobby.offline: Online play is not open on Joutes yet. You can play against the AI or on your own server.
lobby.signInForOnline: Sign in to create or join a table.
lobby.about: The Joutes engine knows the rules: it only offers what is allowed, resolves effects and narrates every event, citing the rule applied. Engine texts are in French for now.

room.title: Online table · {mode}
room.invite: Share this page's link to invite players. Once the game has started, the same link lets people watch it.
room.waitingPlayers: {count, plural, one {# seat still free} other {# seats still free}}
room.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start.
room.signIn: Sign in to take a seat.
room.unreachableHint: The game has started, but the game server is not answering. Reload the page in a moment.

remote.unreachableHint: The host's server is not answering, or the invitation has expired. From an https page, the browser also refuses an unencrypted server (except on your own machine).

host.intro: Start the game server (joutes-server host) on a machine, then enter its address and organizer code here. Each player gets an invitation link. Joutes sees neither the address nor the code.
host.guestDeck: Link to a Joutes deck (empty: automatic deck)
host.needDeck: Choose your deck first, in step 2.
host.unreachable: Server unreachable. Check the address, and that it uses https if this page does.
host.created: The game is created. Send each player their link: it gives access to their seat, and theirs only.
host.tls: From joutes.app (https), the browser only accepts a server over https, or one running on your own machine (localhost).

sim.lobbyHint: Have the AI play your deck over dozens of games and see how many it wins.
sim.title: Simulate a deck
sim.intro: Have the AI play your deck against a specific opponent, or against a deck drawn at random each game, and see how many games it wins.

kindHint.fixed: The same opponent for the whole run.
kindHint.pool: A deck drawn from a pool, game after game.

sim.poolIntro: Each game draws a deck from the ticked pools:

sourceHint.mine: The ones the engine can play
sourceHint.public: The 50 public decks with the most stars
sourceHint.auto: A random deck built around each legend

sim.weighted: Draw meta decks by how often they appear in tournaments (a legend played twice as much comes up twice as often)
sim.poolSummary: {count, plural, one {# possible deck} other {# possible decks}}. Your own deck is left out of the draw.
sim.poolEmpty: Tick at least one pool that has decks.
sim.durationHint: in this browser, with the tab open
sim.fairness: Your deck switches seats every two games and who goes first alternates every game. Easy plays almost at random: it is no use for judging a deck.
sim.saved: Results are saved as they come: closing the tab keeps the games already played.
sim.about1: Your deck's chances when the Joutes AI plays it. The AI reads the game with a simple grid (points, battlefields, board, cards in hand) and doesn't know a deck's game plan.
sim.about2: It favors straightforward aggressive decks and underrates control and combo. Compare two versions of the same deck with each other rather than with meta winrates.
sim.resultHint: {target} games · {level} AI · {pool, plural, one {# possible opposing deck} other {# possible opposing decks}}
sim.deleteConfirm: Delete this simulation and all its games?
sim.otherEngine: These games were played by another version of the engine: "Watch" may show a different game.
sim.paused: Paused: "Resume" picks up where the run stopped
sim.favored: The deck is favored: even the bottom of the range is above 50%.
sim.unfavored: The deck is unfavored: even the top of the range is below 50%.
sim.undecided: Not enough games to tell: the range crosses 50%.
sim.undecidedGames: {count, plural, =0 {no unfinished game} one {# unfinished game} other {# unfinished games}}
sim.byOpponentHint: Grouped by legend. Under {count} games, the number is greyed out.
sim.watchHint: "Watch" reopens the exact same game at the spectator table, with pause and visible hands.

error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Sign in to simulate a deck: results are kept in your account.
error.INVALID_DECK: The engine cannot play this deck.
error.EMPTY_POOL: No opposing deck in the chosen pool.
error.SERVER: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error.ENGINE: The engine failed on a game. Restart the run; if it happens again, please report it.

hand.where: Where to play {name}? Click a highlighted spot.
hand.whereSpell: A spell: drop it anywhere on the table, then choose its targets.

payment.customHint: Click the runes in your base: exhaust, exhaust then recycle, recycle, nothing. A Seal or Gold is used with one click, on the table or below.
payment.extra: Left over: {energy} Energy, {power} Power. The pool empties at the end of the phase.

PlaySwu.title: Play Star Wars: Unlimited
PlaySwu.description: Play Star Wars: Unlimited in your browser against the AI, with your own decks or an automatic one. The engine applies the Premier format rules and cites each of them.

lobby.resumeHint: {players}, {moves, plural, one {# move played} other {# moves played}}.
lobby.sets: The engine plays all nine sets, from Spark of Rebellion to Heroes of Mandalore, in the Premier format.
lobby.watchInfo: You watch the game without playing: the AI hands are visible, and you can pause it.
lobby.about: The Joutes engine knows the rules of Star Wars: Unlimited: it only offers what is allowed, resolves every ability and cites the rule applied in the log.
lobby.deckRandomHint: A leader drawn at random each game
lobby.hostNeedDeck: Choose your deck first, just above.

sim.fairness: Your deck switches seats every two games and the initiative is drawn at random every game. Easy plays almost at random: it is no use for judging a deck.
sim.about1: Your deck's chances when the Joutes AI plays it. The AI reads the game with a simple grid (bases, units in play, resources, cards in hand) and doesn't know a deck's game plan.
sim.about2: It favors straightforward aggressive decks and underrates control and combo. Compare two versions of the same deck with each other rather than with tournament results.
sim.byOpponentHint: Grouped by leader. Under {count} games, the number is greyed out.

sourceHint.auto: A random deck built around each leader
